title: UFO map shows nearly 2,000 sightings across UK - 13 were in Newcastle
excerpt: There have been a number of recorded sightings in Newcastle, Northumberland, Tynemouth, South Shields, Washington, Sunderland and County Durham
content:
There have been a number of recorded sightings in Newcastle, Northumberland, Tynemouth, South Shields, Washington, Sunderland and County Durham

17:14, 01 Nov 2026

A UFO map has revealed hundreds of sightings across the UK over the last five years. And a number of them were in the North East - including 13 in Newcastle.

‌

‌

Nearly 2,000 Unidentified Flying Objects (UFOs) have been documented and logged in the UK by research group UFO Identified. Now, a searchable interactive map, included below, allows you to explore every unexplained encounter logged in your area between 2021 and 2026.

‌

A number of those recorded sightings have taken place in the North East - including 13 in the Newcastle area. There were also sightings in Northumberland, Tynemouth, South Shields, Washington, Sunderland and County Durham.

‌

Meanwhile, strange black triangles speeding above military sites have triggered security concerns in America. And our interactive map reveals identical UFOs have been haunting British skies. Many British accounts closely mirror sightings reported across the Atlantic.

The Pentagon recently published its latest release of declassified files on Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena (UAP – the American term for UFO), following an executive order signed by Donald Trump. Among the documents is an account from two federal agents stationed at a US “sensitive national security site” in June 2026.

According to the report, a matte-black triangular object with an estimated 15-foot wingspan hovered silently roughly 300 feet in the air for 20 seconds before descending into a canyon at high speed without leaving an exhaust trail. While orbs, spheres and “star-like” sightings make up the bulk of British sightings, researchers have logged 164 reports of similar wedge-shaped objects – meaning roughly one in every 12 sightings involves a distinctive triangle.

‌

Witnesses across the country have reported seeing dark, matte triangles gliding soundlessly at low altitude over housing estates, farmland, and coastal areas before darting away at incredible speeds, just like the sighting made by federal agents in the USA. The most recent was on July 22 of this year, when a “large black triangle” featuring a red light on each point was witnessed hovering over Stretford in Greater Manchester for over 30 minutes.

‌

Earlier this year, a “perfect triangle” was seen speeding across the sky above Chesterfield in Derbyshire, a “black V-shaped boomerang” was spotted over the Fylde coast in Lancashire, and a soundless black wedge above Exmouth in Devon. You can check what UFOs have been seen where you live using our interactive gadget.

As well as the North East, our map reveals hotspot areas where clusters of UFOs have been spotted above Greater Manchester, London, Essex, Lancashire, Cheshire, Merseyside, Kent and West Yorkshire. The accounts have been gathered by UFO Identified to create a central, searchable public archive, called the UK UFO Database, to help researchers identify patterns.

‌

Ash Ellis, founder of UFO Identified, said: “There are thousands of people across the UK who have seen something they could not readily explain, but the reports are often difficult to find once the initial interest has passed. We wanted to build a serious, easy-to-use public archive that keeps those accounts accessible and allows people to look for patterns for themselves.”

To examine the UK UFO Database, or report sightings, visit: https://ukufodatabase.co.uk/
